translations.web: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
translations.bsb: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
translations.kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
